description: Transcribed from the Employee Handbook, section V.B Vacation Benefits (1. Eligibility, 2. Accrual, 3. Administration). Reviewed by HR before each change.
assumptions: Regular full-time = employment_type FULL_TIME in the HR source; part-time and temporary employees are not eligible (V.B.1).
An 8-hour workday converts hours to days (3.077 h x 26 periods = 80 h = 10 days).
Biweekly periods are counted from the start date; the handbook does not tie them to a payroll calendar.
The handbook leaves [FISCAL YEAR] blank; fiscal_year_start_month = 1 (January) until HR sets it.
Eligibility is assumed to start on the start date (no record of classification changes).
